capabilities: commit and push vault changes automatically after each save
pull remote changes on a background interval or via a webhook
initialize a repository, set a remote, and generate a .gitignore
pause, resume, and toggle sync from a ribbon menu
show sync state in the status bar
extras: Desktop only; installed by manually copying main.js and manifest.json into the plugins folder. Real rebase conflicts must be resolved manually in a terminal.
problem: Syncing a vault through Git normally requires running commit, push and pull commands by hand, and Obsidian has no built-in way to automate that.

relations.evidence: The plugin can detect your Tailscale IP automatically

requires.name: GitHub repository used as the git remote
Tailscale, cloudflared, or ngrok tunnel to expose the webhook externally

summary: Git-based sync plugin that auto-commits and pushes the vault on every save and pulls remote changes on an interval or webhook trigger.
